vulnerability.explanation: data_buffer_size is computed as 0x40 + initsz + finisz (with initsz/finisz derived from 1 + strlen). If initsz or finisz are very large, the addition can overflow bfd_size_type, causing bfd_zmalloc to allocate a too-small buffer. Subsequent memcpy calls write initsz/finisz bytes at offsets 0x40 and 0x40+initsz (lines 4185 and 4194), leading to heap buffer overflow.
